title: Fullstack Java With Angular-Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Artificial Intelligence & Engineering
  
  
AI & Engineering leverages  cutting-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Level: Software Engineer II
  
  
As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver backend and front-end engineering solutions that support enterprise-scale applications and client transformations. You will apply experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Angular to build maintainable, secure, and scalable solutions while contributing to delivery quality, process improvement, and innovation. This role offers the opportunity to work across modern engineering practices, strengthen technical depth, and support high-quality outcomes in a collaborative environment.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
  
  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing Angular applications using TypeScript, reactive programming patterns, and integration with RESTful services
* Supporting solution design decisions by evaluating technical approaches, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, maintainable, and performant implementations
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Contributing to process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

The Team
  
  
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Core JAVA & Backend engineering
* 4 - 7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
* Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* Angular
* 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in Angular
* Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade angular applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Strong understanding of Angular fundamentals, including components , modules , services , dependency injection (DI) , routing , guards, and forms (template / reactive - driven).
* Proficiency with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables , operators , subscription management and effective error handling patterns.
* Experience implementing state management patterns ( e.g. , NgRx or equivalent), including separation of UI state vs domain state
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
* Hands-on experience integrating Angular applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including interceptors, route guards, and role-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing & Debugging skills with unit tests (Jasmine/Karma/Jest) and end-to-end automation (Playwright/Cypress), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with Angular performance optimization, including lazy loading, change detection strategies, efficient rendering, and bundle optimization
* Familiarity with Angular CLI, environment configuration, build pipelines, and deployment optimization
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
The Legion application is a high-performance, data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. It also provides the necessary endpoints for our Web and mobile frontend applications.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**
As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance.
  
  

* Design, build, and ship features end to end across the backend (Java / Spring Boot services, REST APIs, data model) and the web frontend (React / AngularJS).
* Write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality code that scales to large multi-location customers with complex, highly configurable setups.
* Own the performance of what you build: diagnose slow queries, memory pressure, and large data imports/exports, and fix them at the root cause.
* Keep backend and UI behavior consistent — the API contract, validation, and what the user sees must agree.
* Write unit and integration tests, review peers' code, and hold a high bar on quality and maintainability.
* Write technical design documents for non-trivial changes and break them into incremental, shippable pieces.
* Investigate and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, and tracing; take part in on-call and escalation support for your area.
* Work closely with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements and validate fixes with customers.
* Mentor engineers on the team and raise the technical bar through reviews and design discussions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping software products (not consulting or website/portal development).
* Strong backend experience in Java with Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, and REST API design.
* Strong frontend experience with React or AngularJS, plus JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, including cross-browser compatibility.
* Solid relational database skills with MySQL (or similar): schema design, indexing, query tuning, and migrations.
* Experience with performance and scalability work: profiling, memory and allocation issues, batching, caching, and asynchronous/queue-based processing.
* Experience handling the complexity of many configurations in a multi-tenant, cloud-based product.
* Experience with AWS and containerized deployments.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar field.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.
  
  
If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

**How We Determine What We Pay**

We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
Role Summary:

HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This role sits within the build pool and is responsible for customising and configuring Incubate solutions to deliver the specific business outcomes each customer engagement requires. The Domain and Product FDE acts on behalf of the client. They take the requirements and detailed design produced by the Value Owner and Context and Data Strategist and turn them into working solutions inside the product, designing workflows, configuring orchestrations, building workbenches, and implementing process-led use cases using deep product fluency and domain understanding. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Role Scope in Practice Design, configure, and build customer-specific solutions within Incubate products, including workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases. Work from the documented requirements and detailed design produced by the Context and Data Strategist, translating specification into working product configuration. Apply domain understanding and product fluency to make informed configuration decisions that deliver the desired outcomes without unnecessary custom development. Collaborate with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues where solutions require integration, API connectivity, or technical build beyond product configuration. 2 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Support the Quality and Compliance team by ensuring that what is built is testable, traceable, and aligned to the documented requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in delivery calls and technical discussions where product and domain input is needed, without owning customer communication directly. Contribute to the reuse and maturity of solution patterns, configuration approaches, and domain-specific knowledge across engagements. Configure and maintain the behavioural controls that shape how AI agents operate within each customer's context, including prompt templates, agent personas, business guardrails, and escalation logic, ensuring agents behave in line with the process, the client's operating context, and the documented acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Configuration and Build Design and configure solutions within Incubate products to meet the specific requirements of each customer engagement. Build workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases using the product’s native capabilities and tooling. Make informed decisions about when to use standard product configuration, when to extend or customise, and when to escalate where a requirement may be better addressed through a different approach. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Work iteratively, delivering incremental capability that can be reviewed, validated, and refined through the engagement lifecycle. Design and configure prompt templates, agent personas, and behavioural parameters that control how AI agents interact with users, data, and business processes within each use case. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Advise the Context and Data Strategist and Value Owner where requirements may benefit from adjustment based on product capability or domain insight. Establish and maintain SME feedback loops working with customer subject matter experts to review agent behaviour, validate output quality, and iteratively refine prompt templates and behavioural configuration based on real-world performance. 3 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes 3. Working from Requirements and Detailed Design Take documented requirements and detailed design from the Context and Data Strategist as the primary input for build work. Seek clarification from the Context and Data Strategist where specifications are ambiguous, incomplete, or where product constraints create a gap between what is specified and what can be delivered. Ensure traceability between documented requirements and what is actually built, so that QA and validation activities have a clear baseline. Flag risks, constraints, and dependencies back to the delivery team early, particularly where product limitations or data readiness issues may affect the planned approach. 4. Collaboration and Delivery Integration Work as part of the integrated delivery team, collaborating closely with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues, the Context and Data Strategist, and the Quality and Compliance team. Participate in delivery ceremonies, technical discussions, and review sessions as needed. Support solution walkthroughs and demonstrations where product and domain expertise is required, without owning customer communication directly. Coordinate with other Domain and Product FDEs where multiple use cases or workstreams are running in parallel within an engagement. 5. Quality, Testing, and Handover Ensure that configured solutions are built to a standard that supports effective testing, validation, and acceptance. Support the Quality and Compliance team in validating that delivered solutions meet the documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and governance standards. Contribute to go-live readiness activities, including solution documentation, configuration records, and handover materials for the operate phase. Support operate-phase activities where ongoing configuration, refinement, or extension of solutions is required after initial go-live. 6. Knowledge Sharing and Reuse Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge across the function. Document configuration decisions, design rationale, and lessons learned so that knowledge is retained and transferable. Share product and domain expertise with colleagues across engagements, supporting the function’s ability to mobilise and deliver consistently. Required Experience Experience in a product configuration, solution delivery, or domain specialist role within enterprise software environments. Practical experience designing and building solutions using enterprise software products, configuring workflows, orchestrations, business rules, or process automation. 4 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Demonstrable domain understanding in one or more relevant business areas, able to translate business processes and requirements into product configuration decisions. Experience working from documented requirements and detailed design, collaborating with business analysts or equivalent roles to clarify and refine specifications. Experience working as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team, coordinating with engineering, QA, and advisory colleagues. Comfortable working iteratively, delivering incremental capability and adapting as requirements are refined through delivery. Skills and Capabilities Product fluency: able to work confidently within enterprise software products, using native tooling and configuration capabilities to build effective solutions. Domain understanding: brings practical knowledge of business processes, operational workflows, and industry context that informs how solutions are designed and configured. Configuration judgement: knows when to use standard configuration, when to extend, and when to push back, including the judgement to shape agent behaviour through prompt design and guardrails rather than defaulting to custom development. Analytical thinking: able to interpret requirements, identify gaps or ambiguities, and translate specification into working solutions. Collaboration: works effectively as part of an integrated team, particularly alongside Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration engineers, and QA colleagues. Communication: able to articulate technical decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Attention to detail: builds solutions that are robust, traceable, and aligned to documented requirements. Desirable Experience Experience with HCLSoftware products or comparable enterprise software platforms. Experience in AI, automation, orchestration, or agentic workflow delivery, understanding how product configuration differs when AI is at the centre of the solution. Experience with process mining, process mapping, or operational analytics tools. Familiarity with integration patterns, APIs, and data connectivity in the context of enterprise solution delivery. context and state management, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints around an LLM

branching, retries, parallelism and human-approval gates (e.g. task-token waits); invoke AgentCore runtimes and Lambda
  
  
from workflows

scaling and invocation patterns, and expose tools via AgentCore Gateway

regression tests) to measure agent quality before and after each release

Front End

streaming responses, tool-call visibility, shared state and human approval steps
  
  
Backend

* Basic SQL — query, filter, join; awareness of vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch)
* NoSQL — Working knowledge of document/key-value stores (e.g. Amazon DynamoDB): data modelling, access

patterns, and using them for agent run state and audit trails
  
  
  

* REST API design, JWT / OAuth2

Workflow Automation
  
  
  

* Decompose manual business processes into agent workflows
* Document processing — PDF, Excel, unstructured data extraction and classification

Job Title

Senior Technical Lead Ultima Platform

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Department: Engineering – Platform / Infrastructure

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior (10–15+ years)

Role Summary

Diamanti is seeking a Senior Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and

evolution of the Ultima platform, a Kubernetes-native hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)

appliance.

This role requires deep expertise across Kubernetes internals, CSI and CNI subsystems,

storage architecture, embedded and kernel-level development, and high-performance

networking (including SR-IOV). You will act as a hands-on technical authority, owning

critical platform subsystems end-to-end while also serving as a senior escalation point

for complex customer issues.

Key Responsibilities

Ultima Platform & Storage Architecture Ownership

* Own the end-to-end storage architecture for the Ultima platform, supporting

enterprise-grade, stateful Kubernetes workloads.

* Design and evolve storage solutions across:
* NVMe-based block storage
* Distributed storage concepts
* Performance tiers and failure domains
* Make architectural decisions balancing performance, scalability, durability, and

operational simplicity.

* Define and maintain storage best practices and reference architectures for

internal teams and customers.

CSI-Based Storage Subsystems

* Architect, implement, and optimize Diamanti CSI drivers, including:
* Volume provisioning and lifecycle management
* Snapshots, cloning, resizing, and performance classes
* Failure handling, idempotency, and upgrade safety
* Ensure CSI subsystems integrate correctly with:
* Kubernetes scheduling and lifecycle events
* Kernel block layer and underlying storage hardware
* Drive root cause analysis for complex CSI and storage-related issues.

CNI, Networking & Acceleration

* Own CNI-based networking subsystems, including:
* Pod networking models and isolation
* Network policy enforcement
* Performance-critical data paths
* Lead design and optimization of high-performance networking, including:
* SR-IOV and NIC offloading
* Low-latency, high-throughput data paths
* Ensure tight integration between CNI, kernel networking, and hardware

acceleration.

Embedded & Kernel-Level Development

* Design and develop embedded Linux services, kernel modules, and low-level

platform components.

* Lead kernel-level debugging and optimization across:
* Storage I/O paths
* Networking stacks
* Interrupt handling, memory management, and performance tuning
* Ensure kernel and embedded components meet enterprise reliability and stability

requirements.

Performance, Reliability & Failure Handling

* Own platform performance benchmarking and regression analysis for storage

and networking.

* Define performance baselines (latency, IOPS, throughput) and track them across

releases.

* Design and validate behavior under:
* Disk, node, and network failures
* Power loss and restart scenarios
* Rolling upgrades and scale operations
* Ensure data durability, recoverability, and predictable failure behavior.

Customer Escalations & Technical Leadership

* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues related to:
* Storage, CSI, and CNI subsystems
* Kernel-level and performance-critical problems
* Lead deep-dive investigations into customer-reported issues, working across

Engineering, QA, and Support.

* Provide clear technical guidance and direction to engineering teams during

escalations.

* Ensure customer issues are driven to root cause, resolution, and long-term fix,

not just workarounds.

* Translate customer learnings into product and platform improvements.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across:
* Storage and networking
* CSI/CNI subsystems
* Kernel and embedded development
* Review designs, code, and test plans to ensure high quality, performance, and

maintainability.

* Raise the bar for systems engineering excellence across the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner closely with:
* Product Management to translate customer requirements into technical

solutions

* QA to ensure comprehensive validation of platform subsystems
* Support and Services teams for smooth customer deployments and

escalations

* Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and customer-facing functions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10–15+ years of experience in systems, platform, embedded, or infrastructure

engineering.

Mandatory Requirements

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) – required
* Deep hands-on expertise in:
* Kubernetes architecture and internals
* CSI and CNI frameworks and implementations
* Linux kernel internals and kernel-level development
* Embedded Linux systems

Storage & Networking Expertise

* Strong experience with:
* NVMe and block storage architectures
* Distributed storage concepts
* CSI driver development and lifecycle management
* CNI plugin development and pod networking
* SR-IOV, NIC offloads, and high-performance networking

Preferred / Differentiating Skills

* Experience with Kubernetes-native HCI platforms or appliance-based

infrastructure products.

* Experience working in on-prem, air-gapped, or regulated environments.

Key Success Metrics

* Time-to-resolution and quality of root cause analysis for critical issues.

Why Join Diamanti?

* Own storage, networking, and kernel subsystems with real enterprise impact.
* Act as a key technical authority for customer-critical issues.
* Influence long-term platform architecture and technical direction.

**Senior Specialist – Brand Strategy Analytics (BSA)**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology as we invent for life on behalf of patients around the world. Leading across products and therapeutic areas, the individual will drive a high-performing analytical team to act as a strategic thought partner and help framing critical business questions, integrate diverse healthcare and commercial analytics into actionable recommendations across the commercial lifecycle—from understanding disease and patient flows through opportunity assessment, launch excellence, and brand performance. As a key leadership figure within DHH India, the candidate will influence senior stakeholders, navigate organizational maturity, drive talent strategy and AI-enabled capability building, cross-geography alignment, and the execution of high-impact strategic initiatives that advance our commercial capabilities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Specialist will lead a team of analytical professionals, partnering with US and global brand leaders, and cross-functional partners to translate strategic priorities and ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and decision-ready recommendations. Rather than focusing on individual analyses or isolated datasets, the individual will guide their team to connect insights across multiple analytical sources and capabilities to develop an integrated perspective on patients, markets, competitors, and brand performance, answering three fundamental questions What is happening? Why is it happening? And what should we consider doing next?
  
  
This role requires deep therapeutic-area domain expertise, pharmaceutical commercial acumen, unstructured problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and analytical depth. Leading initiatives end-to-end, the Senior Specialist will manage a strategic analytical roadmap, partner closely with adjacent commercial capabilities—including forecasting, market research, and competitive intelligence—to develop a unified brand perspective. Crucially, the individual will serve as a key driver of DHH and BSA enterprise capability. *State the objective and purpose of the role.*

Lead the machine-learning operations team in India, operating the organisations traditional data-science / ML models in production for example churn prediction, fraud and revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting across the consumer, enterprise (B2B) and network businesses. Own the discipline that keeps predictive models accurate and safe in production: drift monitoring, retraining and validation, deployment and rollback, lineage, and cost. Own the deployment and retraining discipline validation gates (backtest / champion-challenger) before any model is promoted, with a rehearsed rollback path.
